quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter t!
quests.question: t
quests.hint: Look for a tall straight line with a small crossbar near the top. That's how Tiger starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Tiger starts with the lowercase letter t. 🐅
quests.funFact: A tiger's stripes are like fingerprints; no two tigers have the exact same pattern!

quests.instruction: Umbrella starts with this letter. Find the lowercase letter u!
quests.question: u
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Unicorn. 🦄
quests.explanation: Great job finding u! It has a curved dip with a short straight line on the right side.
quests.funFact: The unicorn is the national animal of Scotland!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter v, just like Van?
quests.question: v
quests.explanation: Nice! You found v. It comes right after U.
quests.funFact: There are volcanoes on other planets, and the biggest one is on Mars!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter W!
quests.question: W
quests.hint: Look for four slanted lines dipping up and down, like two V's together. That's how Whale starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Whale starts with the uppercase letter W. 🐋
quests.funFact: The blue whale is the largest animal ever known to have lived on Earth!

quests.instruction: Xylophone starts with this letter. Find the uppercase letter X!
quests.question: X
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts X-ray. 🩻
quests.explanation: Great job finding X! It has two slanted lines crossing in the middle.
quests.funFact: X-rays were discovered completely by accident in 1895!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter Y, just like Yo-yo?
quests.question: Y
quests.explanation: Nice! You found Y. It comes right after X.
quests.funFact: Yaks have larger lungs and hearts than most cattle to help them live in high mountains!

quests.instruction: Find the lowercase letter z!
quests.question: z
quests.hint: Look for a zigzag line -- straight, slanted, then straight again. That's how Zoo starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Zoo starts with the lowercase letter z. 🦁
quests.funFact: The oldest zoo in the world still operating today is in Vienna, built in 1752!

quests.instruction: Apple starts with this letter. Find the lowercase letter a!
quests.question: a
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Astronaut. 🧑‍🚀
quests.explanation: Great job finding a! It has a small circle with a short line on the right side.
quests.funFact: Astronauts can grow up to two inches taller while living in space!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter b, just like Ball?
quests.question: b
quests.explanation: Nice! You found b. It comes right after A.
quests.funFact: Bears have an incredible sense of smell, much better than a dog's!

quests.instruction: Find the uppercase letter C!
quests.question: C
quests.hint: Look for a big curved line, open on the right, like a large moon. That's how Car starts too.
quests.explanation: That's it! Car starts with the uppercase letter C. 🚗
quests.funFact: The first cars didn't have steering wheels; drivers used a lever!

quests.instruction: Dog starts with this letter. Find the uppercase letter D!
quests.question: D
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Dinosaur. 🦖
quests.explanation: Great job finding D! It has a tall straight line with one big round curve on the right.
quests.funFact: Some dinosaurs were as small as a chicken!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter E, just like Elephant?
quests.question: E
quests.explanation: Nice! You found E. It comes right after D.
quests.funFact: Earth is the only planet in our solar system not named after a god!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter f, just like Fish?
quests.question: f
quests.explanation: Nice! You found f. It comes right after E.
quests.funFact: Frogs drink water by absorbing it directly through their skin!

quests.instruction: Giraffe starts with this letter. Find the lowercase letter g!
quests.question: g
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Guitar. 🎸
quests.explanation: Great job finding g! It has a small circle with a curved tail that hangs below the line.
quests.funFact: The world's smallest guitar is no bigger than a single human blood cell!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter h, just like Hat?
quests.question: h
quests.explanation: Nice! You found h. It comes right after G.
quests.funFact: Horses can sleep both standing up and lying down!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter I, just like Ice Cream?
quests.question: I
quests.explanation: Nice! You found I. It comes right after H.
quests.funFact: An igloo can be 40 degrees warmer inside than outside, just from body heat!

quests.instruction: Juice starts with this letter. Find the uppercase letter J!
quests.question: J
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Jellyfish. 🪼
quests.explanation: Great job finding J! It has a tall line that curves into a hook at the bottom.
quests.funFact: Jellyfish don't have brains, hearts, or bones, and are 95% water!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter K, just like Kite?
quests.question: K
quests.explanation: Nice! You found K. It comes right after J.
quests.funFact: Kangaroos use their strong tails for balance, so if you lift their tail, they can't hop!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter l, just like Lion?
quests.question: l
quests.explanation: Nice! You found l. It comes right after K.
quests.funFact: Lemons contain more sugar than strawberries!

quests.instruction: Monkey starts with this letter. Find the lowercase letter m!
quests.question: m
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Moon. 🌙
quests.explanation: Great job finding m! It has two little humps side by side, like two small hills.
quests.funFact: The Moon is slowly drifting away from Earth by about an inch every year!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter n, just like Nest?
quests.question: n
quests.explanation: Nice! You found n. It comes right after M.
quests.funFact: Your nose can remember up to 50,000 different scents!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter O, just like Orange?
quests.question: O
quests.explanation: Nice! You found O. It comes right after N.
quests.funFact: An octopus has three hearts and blue blood!

quests.instruction: Pig starts with this letter. Find the uppercase letter P!
quests.question: P
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Pizza. 🍕
quests.explanation: Great job finding P! It has a tall straight line with one round bump on top.
quests.funFact: The first pizza was created in Naples, Italy, in the 1800s!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter Q, just like Queen?
quests.question: Q
quests.explanation: Nice! You found Q. It comes right after P.
quests.funFact: Quails love to take 'dust baths' to keep their feathers clean!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter r, just like Rabbit?
quests.question: r
quests.explanation: Nice! You found r. It comes right after Q.
quests.funFact: You can only see a rainbow if the sun is completely behind you!

quests.instruction: Sun starts with this letter. Find the lowercase letter s!
quests.question: s
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Snake. 🐍
quests.explanation: Great job finding s! It has a curvy line that curls one way then the other, like a snake.
quests.funFact: Snakes can't blink because they don't have eyelids!

quests.instruction: Can you find the lowercase letter t, just like Tree?
quests.question: t
quests.explanation: Nice! You found t. It comes right after S.
quests.funFact: The fastest train in the world can travel over 280 miles per hour!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter U, just like Umbrella?
quests.question: U
quests.explanation: Nice! You found U. It comes right after T.
quests.funFact: The term UFO was coined by the US Air Force in 1952!

quests.instruction: Van starts with this letter. Find the uppercase letter V!
quests.question: V
quests.hint: This is the letter that starts Violin. 🎻
quests.explanation: Great job finding V! It has two slanted lines meeting in a point at the bottom.
quests.funFact: Playing the violin burns about 170 calories an hour!

quests.instruction: Can you find the uppercase letter W, just like Watermelon?
quests.question: W
quests.explanation: Nice! You found W. It comes right after V.
quests.funFact: Wolves have webbed toes to help them swim and walk on snow easily!
